annotations.title: SSRF-safe URL-to-Markdown extractor with raw wire SHA-256 & HTTP Dat

description: [0.003000 USDC via x402] Fetches any public HTTP/HTTPS webpage through strict DNS/IP SSRF & same-origin redirect guards, computes an immutable SHA-256 digest over the exact raw wire bytes prior to HTML parsing, compares the upstream HTTP Date header against UTC retrieval time, strips scripts/styles/bidi trojans, and returns clean token-efficient Markdown plus structured outbound links for verifiable agent citations.

max_chars.description: Maximum Markdown character budget to return (default 12000, max 64000).

url.description: Public https:// or http:// URL to fetch and convert to forensic Markdown.
